source(output(
		SUM_NET_DUE as string,
		BATCHCNT as string,
		BLIV_CREATE_DTM as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select       INV.BLBL_CREATE_DTM,     SUM(INV.BLEI_NET_DUE) as SUM_NET_DUE,     COUNT(INV.BLIV_ID) as BatchCnt FROM FACETS.CDS_INID_INVOICE INV WHERE EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM FACETS.tblref_BillingBatch_Lkup LKP     WHERE INV.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID     AND INV.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN LKP.GRGR_EFF_DATE and LKP.GRGR_TERM_DATE ) GROUP BY INV.BLBL_CREATE_DTM ORDER BY INV.BLBL_CREATE_DTM',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCOLEDBCDSINIDINVOICE	source(output(
		BatchId as integer,
		BatchCnt as integer,
		BLIVCreateDtm as timestamp,
		BLIVNetDue as decimal(0,0),
		run_datetime as timestamp,
		BatchStatusId as integer,
		BilledAmount as decimal(0,0),
		RanBy as string,
		FileName as string,
		BatchCategoryID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Invoice.Batch',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DFTLKPBATCHIDLKPTABLE
SRCOLEDBCDSINIDINVOICE derive(BatchCategoryId = $BatchCategoryID) ~> DFTDERCBATCHCATEGORYID
DFTDERCBATCHCATEGORYID,DFTLKPBATCHIDLKPTABLE lookup(BLIV_CREATE_DTM == BLIVCreateDtm && DFTDERCBATCHCATEGORYID@BatchCategoryId == DFTLKPBATCHIDLKPTABLE@BatchCategoryID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> DFTLKPBATCHID
DFTLKPBATCHID split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> DFTLKPBATCHIDIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
DFTLKPBATCHIDIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		SUM_NET_DUE as string,
		BATCHCNT as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		BatchCategoryId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SUM_NET_DUE = Param_0,
		BATCHCNT = Param_1,
		BatchId = Param_2,
		BatchCategoryId = Param_3)) ~> DSTOLEDBUPDATEBATCH
DFTLKPBATCHIDIsMatch@NotMatch derive(BatchStatusId = 1,
		BatchRunDttm = notConvertedectfunctiondategetdatef()) ~> DFTDERCBATCHSTATUSIDDATE
DFTDERCBATCHSTATUSIDDATE sink(input(
		BatchCnt as integer,
		run_datetime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BLIVNetDue as decimal(0,0),
		BatchStatusId as integer,
		BLIVCreateDtm as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BatchCategoryID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		BatchCnt = BATCHCNT,
		run_datetime = BatchRunDttm,
		BLIVNetDue = SUM_NET_DUE,
		BatchStatusId,
		BLIVCreateDtm = BLIV_CREATE_DTM,
		BatchCategoryID = BatchCategoryId)) ~> DSTOLEDBINSERTBATCH
